version: v3 rebuild 2026-11-16 (v1/v2 notes superseded; old scene file kept as render/scenes.v2-carried.html)
world: ONE lit skin block in a dim operating theatre. Top face = skin surface in perspective; front face = cross-section (epidermis with rete ridges, dermis with collagen/capillary loops/hair follicle/sweat gland, vessels, fat lobules). The wound runs front-to-back. Warm flesh on navy; teal thread is the single cool accent. The front face intentionally runs off the bottom edge.

intent.camera: scenes are camera moves on the same object with a 0.36 s eased whip between them - not hard cuts
intent.xray: pink top face = the skin cover made translucent on purpose (X-RAY VIEW); it is not a colour error
intent.text: one text system per scene: dark chips / one big stamp; title only on hook and closer
intent.loop: last frame equals frame 0 (open wound, needle poised, same title)

objects: teal suture thread: subcuticular ladder - bite along one edge, cross, bite along the other, 8 passes
surface (interrupted) stitches with knots - the MYTH picture, s0 only
buried end knot in the dermis (s5)
epithelial cells closing over the seam (s8)
vitals monitor ECG, lamp, instrument shelf (room)
accuracy_pass.wow: rete ridges + capillary loops in the section; shaved field with hairs only at the margins

known_simplifications: block proportions are diagrammatic, layer thickness not to scale
knot shown as one bead; real buried knots are several throws
48 h is surface re-epithelialisation of a well-approximated wound (StatPearls NBK532977), not full healing
